name: What should I consider when choosing a new entry door?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a new entry door?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a new entry door, consider materials like steel for security and durability, fiberglass for energy efficiency and low maintenance, or wood for classic aesthetics. Evaluate its R-value or U-factor for insulation performance. Style should complement your home's architecture, including panel design, glass inserts, and hardware finishes. Security features such as multi-point locks and strong frames are also important. We recommend balancing aesthetics, security, energy efficiency, and budget to find the best fit for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider material (steel, fiberglass, wood), energy efficiency (R-value/U-factor), style, and security features when choosing an entry door to balance aesthetics, performance, and budget.
